turns.question: Among the 50 most liquid US stocks, which three had the strongest and which three the weakest returns in February 2026? Separately, what did those six companies disclose in their 8-K filings from January through March 2026? Report the moves and the filings apart, and do not claim that a filing caused a move.

report.markdown:
**February 2026 – 50 most‑liquid U.S. stocks**

| Rank (return) | Ticker | Company (SEC name) | Feb‑2026 return* |
|---------------|--------|-------------------|------------------|
| **1 (strongest)** | **CRCL** | Circle Internet Group Inc. | **+30.20 %** |
| **2** | **AMAT** | Applied Materials Inc. | **+15.76 %** |
| **3** | **NFLX** | Netflix Inc. | **+15.29 %** |
| **48 (weakest)** | **BMNR** | Bitmine Immersion Technologies Inc. | **‑24.44 %** |
| **49** | **IBM** | International Business Machines Corp. | **‑21.68 %** |
| **50** | **CRWD** | CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. | **‑15.73 %** |

\*Return is measured from the close on 31 Jan 2026 to the close on 28 Feb 2026 (19 trading sessions).
Evidence: highest‑return scan [1]; lowest‑return scan [2].

---

## 8‑K filings (Jan – Mar 2026) for the six companies

| Company (ticker) | Filing date(s) | Principal Item(s) disclosed | Brief description |
|------------------|----------------|----------------------------|-------------------|
| **Circle Internet Group (CRCL)** | 25 Feb 2026 | **Item 2.02 – Results of Operations and Financial Condition**; Item 9.01 | Press release with Q4 2025 earnings (fourth‑quarter and full‑year results) [3]. |
| **Applied Materials (AMAT)** | 12 Feb 2026 (two filings: 11 Feb & 12 Feb) | **Item 2.02 – Results of Operations and Financial Condition**; **Item 7.01/8.01 – Other Events** | Q1 FY2026 earnings (quarter ended 25 Jan 2026) and a separate “Other Events” disclosure (details not fully captured in snippet) [4]. |
| **Netflix (NFLX)** | 20 Jan 2026 (two filings) | **Item 2.02 – Results of Operations and Financial Condition** (Q4 2025 earnings) [5]; **Item 1.01 – Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement** (merger agreement with Warner Bros. Discovery) [5]; 27 Feb 2026 | **Item 1.02 – Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement** (the same merger agreement was terminated) [5]. |
| **Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR)** | 15 Jan 2026 | **Item 7.01 – Regulation FD Disclosure** (press release announcing an investment in Beast Industries) [6]; 20 Jan 2026 | **Item 3.03 – Material Modification to Rights of Security Holders** (annual‑meeting approvals) [6]; 26 Jan 2026 | **Item 5.02 – Departure/Appointment of Directors** (Young Kim appointed) [6]; 9 Feb 2026 | **Item 7.01 – Regulation FD Disclosure** (operational update) [6]; 2 Mar 2026 | **Item 7.01 – Regulation FD Disclosure** (operational update) [6]. |
| **International Business Machines (IBM)** | 28 Jan 2026 | **Item 2.02 – Results of Operations and Financial Condition** (Q4 2025 earnings) [7]; 30 Jan 2026 | **Item 5.02 – Election of Director** (Ramon Laguarta elected, effective 1 Mar 2026) [7]; 2 Feb 2026 | **Item 9.01 – Financial Statements and Exhibits** (routine filing) [7]; 3 Mar 2026 | **Item 5.03 – Amendments to Articles of Incorporation/Bylaws** (governance changes) [7]. |
| **CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD)** | 3 Mar 2026 | **Item 2.02 – Results of Operations and Financial Condition** (fiscal Q1 2026 earnings, quarter ended 31 Jan 2026) [8]. |

*The 8‑K items are taken directly from the SEC filings; no causal link between any filing and the February price moves is implied.*

---

### Limitations
* The market‑scan returns are based on the 50‑stock liquidity universe and the 19‑session February window; they are descriptive, not predictive.
* 8‑K retrievals return the most relevant passages (top‑5 per ticker). Some filings may contain additional items not shown in the snippets.
